title: Degree-zero compact support and ordinary lisse adic sections
statement:
Fix the finite-field and coefficient datum of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], with $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, and $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$. Let $X_0$ be a smooth separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$, and let $\mathcal F$ be a lisse $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$-Weil sheaf on $X_0$ [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. Use the completed integral, rationalized, and common-finite-stage coefficient categories in [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology].

There is a lisse adic sheaf $\mathcal L$ on $X$ in the category of [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves] realizing the underlying object of $\mathcal F$, and a natural identification
$$H^0(X,\mathcal F)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{Lisse}(X,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)}(\underline{\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell},\mathcal L).$$
Here the Hom is taken after forgetting the Weil structure, and its elements are the ordinary global adic sections. This identification is the comparison with the completed pro-etale coefficient model, not an assumption that its category is definitionally the same as the inverse-system category.

There is a natural injective $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$-linear map
$$\alpha_{X,\mathcal F}:H_c^0(X,\mathcal F)\hookrightarrow\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{Lisse}(X,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)}(\underline{\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell},\mathcal L).$$
For every $c\in H_c^0(X,\mathcal F)$, the set of points $x\in X$ where the geometric fibre map of the section $\alpha_{X,\mathcal F}(c)$ is nonzero is closed, and its reduced induced closed subscheme is proper over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. Geometric fibres here mean the inverse-limit, rationalized, and scalar-extended fibres specified by [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves]. Neither affineness, connectedness nor a dimension bound on $X$ is assumed.
